title: 第二十五章 天才云集第二十六章 魏雄

read2（）;这数十道目光大多在司马傲和林璎珞的身上停留了几个呼吸时间，偶尔扫过他也只是快速的移开，很显然，林璎珞和司马傲洗凡精魄境初期的修为引起了这些人的注意，至于刚刚达到洗凡英魄境初期的林无缺，直接被这些人无视了。
眸子平静的环顾四方，林无缺发觉这数十道目光皆是来自代表各大主城前来参加百城大战的年轻天才，有男有女，或高傲，或自信，或深沉，在林无缺视线扫过他们之时，大多先是目光一凝，接着似乎察觉到林无缺身上的修为波动，随即露出了不屑的表情。
这一眼看去，林无缺便发觉至少有百十位修为达到洗凡精魄境初期的天才，剩下的还有几十位达到精魄境中期的，不过还有许多天才刻意收敛自己的修为，让其他人无法察觉。
各大主城的年轻天才们各自占据一处，彼此之间并没有太多的言语交流，唯有道道视线不住的相互探寻，无视那些实力相对较弱的，将那些修为强悍或者诡异的一些人做出初次的评估，继而记住他们的样貌。
“嗡”“咻”
……
天边仍有着不少的流光和宝辉从天而降，不断有着各种年轻的新面孔加入进来，络绎不绝，并竟百大主城遍布整个东土，距离百城大战的战场距离有远有近，所以不可能同时到达，龙光主城距此到算是不太远的。
林无缺和司马傲以及林璎珞三人找了一个相对偏僻的角落站着，这白玉石台足有千丈大小，所以尽管有着数百人站在其上，依然显得稀稀落落，林无缺的这一番观察下来，倒是发现了一些值得注意的年轻天才。
距离他们十数丈远的东面，站着两男一女，以女子为首，正是先前在天边看到的那个体态纤盈，拥有一双长腿的女子。此刻她脸上没有了任何遮挡，漂亮的容颜完全暴露在空气中，此女身材极为的高挑，包裹在白绿相间的贴身武裙中，形成一个惊人的弧度，极其诱人，但此女浑身散发出一股逼人的英气，使得她看起来极为的坚韧和好强！而在她的身后，左右两边各自站着两位年轻男子，左边的沉默寡言，右边的则在到处张望。
这三人的修为竟然全部达到了洗凡精魄境中期，在所有的主城当中，也是极为的出色，所以这三人身上聚集了诸多人的目光。
眼中思量的神色一闪而逝，林无缺将目光移开，在距离他东北的方向站着三个年轻男子，为首一人，犹如鹤立鸡群，好似从千年冰山中走出，寒气直冒，黑色武袍，双目微闭，负手而立，一身气息似渊似海，浮浮沉沉，很是可怕。
“此人极为厉害，最少是精魄境后期的修为，或许还会更强。”
只是林无缺看此人的样貌，似乎比之大多数其他天才要大上一两岁。
似乎察觉到林无缺的目光，此人眼睛突然睁开，目光凌厉霸道，同样看向林无缺，两人的目光撞在了一起，待发现了林无缺的修为后，此人便再度的闭了起来，林无缺也收回了目光，只是他没有看见，此人双眼随即突然再度睁开，目光犹如凝着两块冰，细细打量着林无缺。
“看来那个双拳如火的修士是打定注意要给我制造些麻烦了……”

此刻在距离林无缺三人的西面十丈的距离外，站着三个皆是身穿紫色武袍的修士，当中站在最后的那一人，正是先前火烧云里那个对林无缺做出抹脖子的岳乘风，此时岳乘风的目光依旧盯着林无缺，眼中闪烁着危险的光芒，脸上不时掠过丝丝怒意和屈辱。
只是林无缺的目光不是再看向他，而是站在他前面的另外两人，那两人修为很高，尤其是为首一人，面容红枣，隐隐缭绕一抹炽热，显然是身怀一门造诣极高的火系功法或者战斗绝学。
正当林无缺准备收回目光之时，突然发现那个双拳如火的修士脸色大变，出于好奇，林无缺顺着他的目光看去，随即眼中也是闪过了一丝火热。

“风采臣……”
林无缺看到了那个在始古之森的持剑少年风采臣，风采臣一身白色武袍，面容英挺，身后背负一柄长剑，仿佛他只是站在那里，便散发出一股锋锐无匹的气息，似乎他的人和他的剑早已经合为了一体……在他的身后，也站着两个身背长剑的一男一女，三人的神情如出一辙。
“风采臣，呵呵，你说在百城大战等着我，如今林某来了，真是……期待与你一战呐。”
感受着风采臣散发出来属于剑修独有的锋芒，林无缺的心在这一刻完全火热起来，他的目光如电，刺向风采臣，林无缺知道，风采臣一定会感应到。
“吟”
似乎隐隐响起一声剑鸣，在林无缺充满战意的目光下，风采臣的剑轻轻的颤鸣起来，风采臣微闭的目光刹那间睁开，双眼如剑，双目如芒，第一时间便察觉到来自林无缺的目光！
“啪”
二人的目光瞬间在空中交汇，风采臣的眸子清亮无比，在看到林无缺之后，他那如剑如芒的眸子恍若一下子亮了起来，紧紧的看向林无缺！
“风采臣，我叫林无缺，百城大战，我来了……”
嘴唇微动，林无缺轻轻说出这句话，目光当中的战意昂扬，他从风采臣身上感受到一股让他浑身忍不住兴奋颤抖的强悍气息！
“我的剑竟然会发出鸣响……很好，林无缺，你更加强大了，此番百城大战，风采臣……不虚此行！”

read2(); Most of these dozens of gazes stayed on Sima Ao and Lin Yingluo for a few breaths. Occasionally they glanced at him and quickly moved away. It was obvious that Lin Yingluo and Sima Ao's early cultivation of the mortal spirit realm had attracted the attention of these people. As for Lin Wuque, who had just reached the early stage of the extraordinary heroic realm, he was directly ignored by these people.
Looking around calmly, Lin Wuque realized that these dozens of glances came from young geniuses who came to participate in the Hundred Cities War on behalf of major cities. There were men and women, some were arrogant, some were confident, some were deep. When Lin Wuque glanced at them, most of them stared at them for a moment, then seemed to notice the fluctuation in Lin Wuque's cultivation, and then showed a disdainful expression.
At this glance, Lin Wuque realized that there were at least a hundred geniuses who had reached the early stage of the Pure Soul Realm, and dozens more who had reached the middle stage of the Pure Soul Realm. However, there were still many geniuses who deliberately restrained their cultivation so that others could not detect it.
The young geniuses in the major cities each occupy a place, and there is not much verbal communication between them. They can only look at each other constantly, ignoring those who are relatively weak, and make an initial assessment of those with strong or strange cultivation, and then remember their appearance.
"Buzz" "Boom"
…
There are still a lot of streams of light and treasures falling from the sky, and various young and new faces are constantly joining in, and there is an endless stream. There are actually hundreds of main cities spread across the entire eastern land. They are far or near from the battlefield of the Hundred Cities War, so it is impossible to arrive at the same time. The main city of Longguang is not too far away.
Lin Wuque, Sima Ao and Lin Yingluo found a relatively remote corner to stand. The white jade stone platform was a thousand feet in size, so even though there were hundreds of people standing on it, it still seemed sparse. After Lin Wuque's observation, he discovered some young talents worth noting.
To the east, more than ten feet away from them, stood two men and one woman, led by the woman. She was the slender woman with long legs that she had seen on the horizon before. At this moment, there is no cover on her face, and her beautiful face is completely exposed to the air. This woman has an extremely tall figure, wrapped in a white and green close-fitting military skirt, forming an amazing arc, which is extremely attractive, but this woman exudes a compelling heroic spirit, making her look extremely tough and strong! Behind her, there were two young men standing on the left and right. The one on the left was silent, while the one on the right was looking around.
The cultivation levels of these three people have all reached the middle stage of the Cleansing Mortal Spirit Realm. Among all the main cities, they are also extremely outstanding, so these three people have gathered the attention of many people.
The thoughtful look in his eyes flashed away, and Lin Wuque looked away. Standing northeast of him were three young men. The leader stood out like a chicken, as if he had stepped out of a thousand-year-old iceberg. The cold air was coming out of him. He was wearing a black military robe, his eyes were slightly closed, and he stood with his hands behind his back. His aura was like an abyss or a sea, floating and sinking, which was very scary.
"This person is extremely powerful. He is at least at the late stage of Jingso Realm, and may be even stronger."
It's just that Lin Wuque's appearance seemed to be a year or two older than most other geniuses.
As if aware of Lin Wuque's gaze, the man's eyes suddenly opened, his eyes were sharp and domineering, and he also looked at Lin Wuque. Their eyes collided. After discovering Lin Wuque's cultivation level, the man closed his eyes again. Lin Wuque also retracted his gaze, but he did not see it. The man's eyes suddenly opened again, his gaze was like two pieces of ice, and he looked at Lin Wuque carefully.
"It seems that the monk with fists like fire is determined to cause some trouble for me..."

At this moment, ten feet away to the west of Lin Wuque and the others, there were three people standing, all wearing purple.Among the monks in martial robes, the one standing at the end was Yue Chengfeng, who had wiped Lin Wuque's neck in the burning cloud. At this time, Yue Chengfeng was still staring at Lin Wuque, with a dangerous light flashing in his eyes, and traces of anger and humiliation flashed across his face from time to time.
But Lin Wuque's eyes were not looking at him anymore, but at the other two people standing in front of him. Those two people were very advanced, especially the first one, who had a red face and a faint glow. He obviously possessed a very accomplished fire-based technique or a unique fighting skill.
Just when Lin Wuque was about to withdraw his gaze, he suddenly noticed that the face of the monk whose fists were like fire changed drastically. Out of curiosity, Lin Wuque followed his gaze, and then a trace of fire flashed in his eyes.
"Feng Caichen..."
Lin Wuque saw the sword-wielding young man Feng Caichen in the Ancient Forest. Feng Caichen was dressed in a white military robe, with a handsome face and a long sword on his back. It was as if he was exuding a sharp aura just by standing there. It seemed that his person and his sword had already become one... Behind him, there were also two men and a woman standing with long swords on their backs. The expressions of the three of them were exactly the same.
"Feng Caichen, hehe, you said you would wait for me in the Hundred Cities Battle. Now that Lin is here, I really... look forward to a battle with you."
Feeling Feng Caichen's unique edge as a swordsman, Lin Wuque's heart was completely heated at this moment. His eyes were like lightning, piercing Feng Caichen. Lin Wuque knew that Feng Caichen would definitely feel it.
"Yin"
There seemed to be a faint sound of sword sound, and under Lin Wuque's war-filled gaze, Feng Caichen's sword trembled slightly. Feng Caichen's slightly closed eyes opened in an instant, his eyes were like swords, and his eyes were like lights. He immediately noticed the gaze from Lin Wuque!
"Pa"
The two people's eyes met in the air for an instant. Feng Caichen's eyes were extremely clear. After seeing Lin Wuque, his sword-like eyes suddenly lit up and he looked at Lin Wuque closely!
"Feng Caichen, my name is Lin Wuque, I'm here for the Hundred Cities Battle..."
With his lips moving slightly, Lin Wuque said these words softly, with a fighting spirit in his eyes. He felt a powerful aura from Feng Caichen that made his whole body tremble with excitement!
"My sword can actually make a sound... Very good, Lin Wuque, you are even stronger. This battle of a hundred cities, Feng Caichen... is a worthwhile trip!"
